episodes.synopsis: Ame is restrained by the Mad Dentist and is about to undergo dangerous cavity treatment. It's a desperate crisis! But is there a secret in Ame's mouth...?
episodes.title: Beware the Mad Dentist

episodes.synopsis: Caries, a cavity, remodels Ame's teeth without asking and pushes her around. Seeing that Ame can't fit in with her friends, Caries tries to solve it with her specialty: DIY.
episodes.title: Ame's Cavity

episodes.synopsis: Ame is happy that her baby tooth fell out. But that was Caries' precious TV! Caries carefully nurtures the newly growing tooth, eventually growing it into a giant TV, but...
episodes.title: TV Raising Project

episodes.synopsis: Ame is banned from eating sweets by her mom. Unable to watch Caries suffer from not eating sweets, her friend Mikan secretly gives them sugar, but they get involved in unexpected trouble.
episodes.title: Is the White Powder Dangerous?

episodes.synopsis: When Ame wakes up, Caries and a mysterious fish, Harold, are flirting inside her mouth! Ame doesn't accept Harold, who claims to be Caries' boyfriend. However, Caries is head over heels for Harold...
episodes.title: Pushed Around by Him

episodes.synopsis: Believing the rumor of the Tooth Fairy who "exchanges lost teeth for money," Ame and friends sleep with teeth under their pillows. But they were all stolen! Caries stands up for the sake of the children.
episodes.title: Catch the Tooth Thief

episodes.synopsis: Mom took Ame to... the dentist!? If the cavity is found, it's game over! Ame and Caries panic and frantically clean up Caries' room, but...
episodes.title: The Dentist Isn't Scary

episodes.synopsis: Ame finds a toy she wants and tries throwing a tantrum imitating Mikan and the others, but she isn't making enough noise to get it bought. Unable to watch, Caries helps her out, but...
episodes.title: The Tantrum Rampage

episodes.synopsis: The real Tooth Fairy got caught in the trap set to catch the tooth thief!? They immediately try to exchange the lost tooth for money, but the Tooth Fairy's assessment is stricter than imagined.
episodes.title: The Tooth Fairy

episodes.synopsis: Caries fights with Ame and storms out of the room. She relies on Mikan and the others, trying to get them to let her stay in their mouths, but...
episodes.title: Caries Moves Out

episodes.synopsis: A massive amount of teeth growing inside Caries' room! It seems Ame entered a cursed place. To increase the teeth, Caries tries various curses on Ame.
episodes.title: Curses Make Money

episodes.synopsis: Ame and Caries write letters for what they want for Christmas. However, the presents don't arrive, and Caries gets depressed. Just then, a certain surprise arrives.
episodes.title: Operation: Christmas

episodes.synopsis: The city is attacked by aliens! Ame and friends are abducted by a UFO and are in a huge pinch. Can they escape from the UFO with Mikan and Beef...?
episodes.title: Alien Abduction

episodes.synopsis: Ame sighs, unable to hand an envelope to a certain man. "Could it be Mom's first love!?" Caries goes to deliver the love letter in Ame's place.
episodes.title: In Place of Mom

episodes.synopsis: Harold has a secret child!? Caries is furious, but it was actually a baby living inside Harold's mouth. Caries is entrusted with the baby and struggles with parenting for the first time.
episodes.title: Parenting Isn't Easy

episodes.synopsis: Caries becomes famous as a new species of UMA due to a video Mikan posted. A large crowd rushes to Ame's house to catch a glimpse of Caries.
episodes.title: UMA Exists!

episodes.synopsis: Ame tries to pull out a loose baby tooth. Caries, not wanting her furniture removed, remodels the baby tooth into a security AI robot, "Giga-Teeth," but...
episodes.title: Guardian Giga-Teeth

episodes.synopsis: The children enjoy a food tour. However, they are refused entry at a high-end restaurant. Caries comes up with a plan for the sad Ame and friends.
episodes.title: No Entry Allowed

episodes.synopsis: Ame catches a cold and is bedridden. Caries dives into Ame's body to search for the cause of the cold and finds a virus tormenting Ame there.
episodes.title: Caries' Body Journey

episodes.synopsis: Because she forgot to brush her teeth, a massive number of Caries clones appear!? Caries is pushed around by the clones living as they please inside Ame's mouth...
episodes.title: Full of Cavities

episodes.synopsis: Mikan does a livestream closely following Caries' life. Caries struggles to make a cake during the stream, but she can't gather the ingredients as she hoped...
episodes.title: Caries Cooking

episodes.synopsis: A no-rules kart race is held where racers proceed while getting sweets on the course. Using every trick in the book to overtake rivals, who on earth will take first place!?
episodes.title: Wacky Kart Race

episodes.synopsis: Caries has left Ame's mouth. It seems Caries has become independent. To let go of her child, Ame resolves to undergo the dental treatment she hates...
episodes.title: Goodbye Caries: Part 1
